question: Which of the following countries had a higher average population density than India in 2020 as per Food and Agriculture Organization and World Bank population estimates?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ Bangladesh .__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Population density is determined as the **number of people existing per square kilometre.**
 
• Bangladesh has additional population density than India which is **51,703 persons per square kilometre**.
 
• Bangladesh ranks at **number eight** in the record of countries by population.
 
• The population richness in Bangladesh is **1265 per Km2 (3,277 people per mi2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Russia's population** is equal to 1.87% of the total world population.

 
 
• Russia ranks at number nine in the record of countries by population.
 
• The population richness in Russia is** 9 per Km2 (23 people per mi2).**
 
 
 
• The population richness in Sri Lanka is **341 per Km2 (884 people per mi2).**
 
• China's population is equal to 1**8.47% of the total world population.**
 
 
• China **ranks at number two** in the record of countries by population. 
 
• The population richness in China is **153 per Km2 (397 people per mi2).​ **
